review_scope: Bounded, read-only exact J4 primary-part body datum and pin-1 transform review. No active/frozen source edits, browser actions, uploads, substitutions, or commits.
result: Body datum and pin-1 transform screening pass. Exact-part mechanical/manufacturing compatibility remains qualified by existing land-pattern and board-thickness differences.

native_source_facts.namespace_warning: HCTL footprint namespace and embedded description refer to a stock HCTL C2894897 part and its 5 A claim. They are not primary SHOU HAN identity/rating evidence. BOM and exact part properties select SHOU HAN C2765186.
native_source_facts.pin1_Fab_marker: V-shaped mark about x=-3.2 at the rear body edge, consistent with A1/B12.

derived_geometry_facts.fact: Forward shell-lug center y=+1.075 plus supplier front offset 2.60 gives body front y=+3.675. Subtracting body length 7.35 gives body rear y=-3.675. The body geometric center is therefore footprint origin (0,0).
Body width 8.94 is symmetric about shell-lug and locator rows, so body x bounds are +/-4.47.
Body front is native board y=40.0 mm, matching the lower Edge.Cuts boundary; existing footprint opening direction is +local Y.
For front-side rotation 0 and CPL y=-board y, A1/B12 local offset (-3.2,-3.745) maps to CPL vector (-3.2,+3.745) and absolute CPL (68.8,-32.58).
Existing J4 anchor is body center, not pad bounding-box center or rear signal-contact-row center. No body-datum shift or 180-degree correction is indicated.
Drawing physical-land order and native pad numbering/net names agree for all 12 physical lands representing 16 USB contacts.

Actual forward tab 0.8 +/-0.15 mm gives 0.65...0.95 mm width. A 1.20 mm nominal slot is 0.40 mm longer than nominal tab and 0.25 mm longer than maximum printed tab width. This is conditional clearance in the long-slot direction only; no as-fabricated slot tolerance or full positional tolerance stack is assumed.
Actual rear tab 1.1 +/-0.15 mm gives 0.95...1.25 mm width, below native rear slot nominal length 1.70 mm.

If the rear-view 1.00 +/-0.10 mm projection is measured from board-top seating level, on a nominal 1.60 mm board the lug ends would be recessed 0.50...0.70 mm from the board bottom. On a nominal 0.80 mm board they would protrude 0.10...0.30 mm.

A short lug within a through hole does not itself obstruct nominal insertion or seating. The source establishes a change in bottom-side accessibility/protrusion, not an authenticated inability to insert, seat, or make top-side SMT contact.

Native signal lands span local y=-4.395...-3.095 mm while body rear is y=-3.675. Thus they extend 0.720 mm beyond the rear body and 0.580 mm under it. The printed 0.30 mm rearward solder-tail projection lies within this native longitudinal pad extent under the drawing body datum. No nominal loss of contact in this direction is demonstrated.

authentic_uncertainties.fact: Supplier recommended layout thickness 0.80 mm differs from native board 1.60 mm. The source reviewed does not state an allowed board-thickness range. This is not proof of incompatibility, but exact-part through-board fit/retention needs supplier or assembler confirmation.

Forward shell slot and annular pad are 0.20 mm shorter than the exact supplier recommendation. The HCTL-derived land pattern is therefore not a literal exact-part recommended-layout match. Differences already exist in frozen Rev3A; no changes were made.

Native signal lands are 1.30 mm tall versus drawing callout 1.17 mm. The drawing itself has a 0.02 mm inconsistency between that callout and 5.32-4.17 mm. No exact recommended y-center was asserted from those inconsistent dimensions.

Drawing does not specify a pick-and-place origin or tape-feed orientation. Body-centered native origin and pin map are supported; this review does not verify an assembler proprietary model transform or a quote preview.

Locally named J4 SHOU HAN 16PIN model carries STEP FILE_NAME USB-C-SMD_TYPE-C-6PIN-2MD-073.step. It was not used as primary datum/pin-assignment evidence. Source mapping from that STEP to the exact 16-contact SKU was not established in this review.

Supplied current PCB SHA256 796cad8c57bd229f138da461483d9d91551f158c40fd6837ca47beaaff7fc240 was already replaced when read. Reviewed snapshot is 5e41644ab8741f0d9f9dfb3734e223b5dda0f7d2ca1abe33400a74b6356135fa; full J4 content is unchanged from frozen after ignoring only global net-ID renumbering.

No nominal shell-tab insertion failure or top SMT contact failure is established by the printed dimensions. Native finished-hole tolerance, full tab/locator positional tolerance stack, tab thickness in the narrow-slot direction, and seating/contact coplanarity are not sufficiently specified here to assert a complete worst-case fit pass.

A thicker PCB likely leaves the approximately 1.00 mm lugs recessed from its bottom if the contact-level line is the board-top datum. Minimum protrusion, wetting/fill process, and retention acceptance requirements are unstated. Supplier/assembler confirmation or an exact-part fit/reflow sample is a conditional qualification recommendation, not an authenticated incompatibility.

actual_tab_and_seating_followup.requested_question: Do actual tab dimensions/seating detail prove nominal incompatibility at native 1.20 mm forward slots and 1.60 mm board?
actual_tab_and_seating_followup.answer: No authenticated nominal insertion, seating, or top-contact failure is established. Printed tab widths fit the native nominal long-slot dimensions. Interpreted 1.00 mm projection would leave recessed lug ends on a 1.60 mm board, leaving solder/retention qualification open.
actual_tab_and_seating_followup.conditional_recommendation: Confirm this exact SHOU HAN SKU at native 1.20 mm forward slots and 1.60 mm board with supplier/assembler or a fit/reflow sample. Do not call the recommendation an authenticated incompatibility or change footprint geometry solely from this bounded review.
